product_summary: Bengaluru (Peenya) designer/manufacturer of co-rotating twin-screw extruders and continuous-processing platforms. Product lines named on steerworld.com: extruder series OMega, mEGA, TITAN, XLNT+, aLPHA, Lab Series, ηeti Series, SAFEReCYCLER Series; EPZ components & peripherals — screw elements, barrels and liners, screw shafts, vacuum stuffers, feeders; plus turnkey lines, installation/commissioning and equipment life-cycle services. Application segments: polymers & plastics compounding, pharmaceuticals (continuous granulation, hot-melt extrusion, PureMelt bioavailability enhancement, effervescent tablets), food & nutraceuticals, biomass processing/biorefining, plastic-waste recycling, sustainable materials (UnWood). Sources: https://www.steerworld.com/ (home page: 'World's Leading Twin-Screw Extruders for Polymer Processing', industry segments, equipment menu), https://www.steerworld.com/about-us/ (founded 1993 by Dr. Babu Padmanabhan; 'design and manufacture of advanced technology platforms in plastics & polymers, pharmaceuticals, food, nutraceuticals, biomaterials and biorefining'), https://www.steerworld.com/contact-us/ (area-of-interest list: EPZ components, polymer equipment, biomass, plastic waste, pharma, continuous granulation & HME, nutraceuticals, food processing systems, UnWood).
comment: HS 8477.20 (extruders) and 8477.90 (parts of 8477 machines) are correct and fully corroborated by the company's own product pages — twin-screw extruders and their screw elements/barrels/shafts are exactly these headings. Match = partial only because the declared pair covers just the polymer-extrusion core and omits the rest of the real product line: (a) other plastics/rubber-processing machinery beyond extruders (8477.80/8477.90 for the SAFEReCYCLER recycling line, feeders/vacuum stuffers as 8477.90 or 8428/8479 auxiliaries); (b) pharmaceutical/food continuous-processing equipment — granulators, hot-melt extruders for pharma, particle-engineering and tablet-related units — which fall outside 8477 (8479.82 mixing/kneading machines, 8479.89, 8419.89 for heated processing apparatus); (c) biomass/biorefining and UnWood lines (8479.30/8479.89). Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a misclassification: the company is a machinery/equipment builder for polymers, pharma, food and biomaterials, not an oil-and-gas or chemical producer — the closest true segment is chemical/polymer processing equipment. No trader signs: own R&D, design, manufacturing, metallurgy and automation capabilities are stated on the site, so manufacturer role. All product claims here are from the company's own website and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line was checked in this task (per role scope, registries and shipment volumes were not researched). No HS-based rejection: company retained, codes to be extended to the actual line.
